label: Billion BiPAC 8800NL R2 Wireless-N VDSL2/ADSL2+ router
description: VDSL2 (profiles up to 17a, 100 Mbit/s down / 50 Mbit/s up) and ADSL2+ firewall router with a 2.4 GHz 802.11n access point at 300 Mbit/s, one RJ-11 DSL port, four 10/100 Ethernet LAN ports and a fifth gigabit port that works as LAN 5 or as an EWAN uplink.
notes: Official user manual, Hardware Specifications / Physical Interface: 'Ethernet: 4-port 10/100 Mbps auto-crossover (MDI/MDI-X) Switch' and 'EWAN: 1 Gigabit Ethernet port (port#5) ... also serving as an Ethernet port#5 when not in EWAN use'. VDSL2 compliance lists profiles 8a-17a only (no 30a/35b), so the line is 100M. The four LAN ports really are Fast Ethernet - a common source of the 'gigabit DSL modem' defect.
